premise: Sumi Aster, a roboticist with expertise in motion planning, fleet arbitration and sensor fusion, must coordinate fallible repair drones to salvage essential infrastructure before life-support imbalance reaches the ring garden habitat.

an unreliable autonomous contractor gains authority without independent evidence
The ring garden habitat becomes inaccessible beyond rotating arboretums
